subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I read the directions, but I still can't __figured out__ how it works.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the underlined part uses the phrase** "figured out,"** which is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"figure out" **to match the present tense used earlier in the sentence **("I read the directions, but I still can't"**).
 
• Therefore, the correct replacement for the underlined part is **"figure out."**

Hence, the correct statement is **"*I read the directions, but I still can't figure out__ how it works*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When correcting sentences, always ensure the verb tense matches the context of the sentence.
 
• In this case, since "read" is in the past tense but "can't" is in the present tense, the phrase "figure out" should also be in the present tense to maintain consistency.
